payload.body: vc review of c454de2 (ST0001 WP01), read only: the static review passes. AC-01.1: the runner execs bats and test.yml runs it directly, so CI gets bats' exit status. AC-01.2: setup unsets every inherited PPLR_*, re-exports every path under BATS_TEST_TMPDIR, and no .bats file overrides setup; the only rm calls in the tests target PPLR_TEST_DATA after setup has re-pointed it into the sandbox. AC-01.3: PPLR_UNDER_TEST, defaulting to bin/pplr. Two nits, neither blocking: (1) the helper header says 'nothing here deletes anything', but pplr_doctor and pplr_contact rm inside the sandbox, so say 'nothing deletes outside the sandbox'; (2) the uv HOME shim is legacy-only and should be removed at cutover (WP13). I'll tick AC-01.1 to 01.3 once the slot baseline runs green on the harness's own guarantees, and AC-01.4 after the CI runs and the triage are recorded. The slot is waiting on hv's yes for vc to take control.
